about: Act 3: the four roads, each with a crisis, a low point and a climax that decides who holds the segments when Cargo 3 begins.

segments_common.about: the segments are common ground in the Hansa's charter: watched by all, owned by none

segments_rostrom.about: House Rostrom and the Concord hold the segments

segments_dawn.about: the Binary Dawn keeps the segments' timing; nobody else can turn them

ran_the_blockade.about: the captain ran a needle through the Mandate's closed buoys

bought_the_drive_vote.about: the captain bought the votes that made the segments common ground

sold_the_decoy.about: the captain sold a Mandate decoy's schedule to pirates

told_serac.about: the captain told Serac what a segment does to clocks

volunteered_for_the_door.about: the captain volunteered to fly through the segment for House Rostrom

paid_with_the_pellet.about: the captain paid for a young captain's drink with a Hansa Mark from before there were any

carried_nodes.about: the captain carried machines out of the Mandate's census

road.hansa.blockade.title: The buoys close
text: The Mandate closes Sol's departure buoys 'for safety, after the segment'. Needles stack up at every buoy in the near systems, a hundred haulers in each file, perishables going soft.
The Hansa asks its captains for the oldest trick there is: get the cargo through anyway.

choices.say: Run a needle through the closed buoy
Fly behind Grab {convoy_captain.short}'s lead hauler
Haul food and water out to the stranded files (5,000)
Sell your place in the queue to a Concord house (15,000)

road.hansa.licence.title: The licence
text: House Bekkenheim announces that a segment's throw infringes its drive licence, and that every lead hauler's licence comes up for renewal this year. At three times the price.
The Hansa cannot pay for all of them. Without licences the needles stop, and the league with them. It asks its captains what they can put in the chest.

choices.say: Put everything you have in Hansa bonds into the chest
Pay one lead hauler's licence yourself (50,000)
Sign the appeal first, as a founder
Call in House Rostrom's old debt to you
Find out who in House Bekkenheim owes favours

road.hansa.vote.title: The vote on the drive
text: The Concord's assembly meets at Epsilon to vote on what a segment is: licensed property, or common ground like the lanes themselves. The galleries are full of haulers who flew in on their own account.
Forty years ago a vote here made the Mark law. You have a seat in the gallery, and the floor if you want it.

choices.say: Speak for common ground
Speak again, forty years after the Mark
Bring the convoys into the gallery
Buy the votes you are short of (100,000)
Vote for the Hansa to own them

text: The Concord's assembly meets at Epsilon to vote on what a segment is: licensed property, or common ground like the lanes themselves. The galleries are full of haulers who flew in on their own account.
Forty years ago a vote here made the Mark law. You have a seat in the gallery, and the floor if you want it.
Some of the old captains in the gallery remember your last speech here. They have come to hear the next one.

road.mandate.decoys.title: Decoys
text: Every jump shows on the Mandate's gravity-wave observatories like a lighthouse, so the Mandate lights false ones. A decoy needle needs a real ship at its head, and pirates go for decoys first.
{serac}'s office would like you to lead one. The pay is good. The paperwork says 'escort duty'.

choices.say: Lead the decoy needle
Refuse: you fly cargo, not bait
Sell the decoy's schedule to the pirates (20,000)
Remind his office of your commission and lead it as an officer

road.mandate.list.title: {serac}'s list
text: Two officers in Mandate grey are waiting at your berth. {serac} keeps a list of the captains who saw a segment turn, and he would like a word with each of them. Today it is you.
He has not aged a day since the photographs in your old newsfeeds. He offers tea, and asks what the segment did to the clocks on your ship.

choices.say: Tell him everything
Remind him who named him at the last inquiry
Offer him the favour you still owe
Drink the tea and tell him nothing

road.mandate.taking.title: Safeguarding
text: The Mandate moves to take the segments: three frigates and a decoy needle at the edge of the Stator Field, and an order of the day that calls it 'safeguarding'.
Somebody has to fly the cargo tug that couples to the segment. {serac} has put your name down. So, quietly, has the Hansa.

choices.say: Couple the tug for the Mandate
Couple it, and turn the tug towards the Hansa's buoy
Stay with the haulers in the decoy needle, as you did forty years ago

road.door.second_turn.title: The second turn
text: The segment is not dead. It turns again, once, and a survey boat that was too close comes out of the turn with its clocks nine days fast.
House Rostrom wants measurements of the next turn from closer than anybody sane would fly.

choices.say: Send a probe in and read it from a distance
Fly the instruments in yourself
Sell your readings to House Bekkenheim (25,000)

road.door.clocks.title: Two clocks
text: {ysolde} is three hundred years old by the calendar and seventy by her own clocks, and she has stopped trusting either. Her test pilot came back from a turn eleven years older. His ship's log says eleven minutes.
'It is not a catapult,' she says. 'It is a door. Doors go both ways. I need a captain who will fly through on purpose, and come back to say so.'

choices.say: Say yes
Ask her about the fourth test, and whose name is on the drive
Say yes, for a share of House Rostrom (50,000)

road.door.through.title: Through the door
text: The segment turns under you, and you come out in an outpost's docking ring you know, forty years ago. The bar is where it always was. A young captain sits on a stool with an empty glass and a loan that is due.
In your pocket there is a pellet of metal stamped with a registry number: a Hansa Mark, from a time when there were none yet. You did not put it there.

choices.say: Pay for the young captain's drink with the pellet
Keep the pellet, and leave the young captain to their own luck
Write the segment's turn into the bar's ledger for whoever comes next

text: The segment turns under you, and you come out in an outpost's docking ring you know, forty years ago. The bar is where it always was. A young captain sits on a stool with an empty glass and a loan that is due.

It is you. You know because you remember the old hauler who sat down next to you that night, and paid with a pellet that you have carried for forty years. You feel for it in your pocket. It is there, worn smooth. So is the new one.

The segment turns under you, and you come out in an outpost's docking ring you know, forty years ago. The bar is where it always was. A young captain sits on a stool with an empty glass and a loan that is due.
It is you. You remember an old hauler who sat down next to you that night and talked about needles before there were needles. The pellet in your pocket is warm.

dawn.crate.title: A crate for nobody
text: A loader robot rolls a sealed crate up your ramp. The manifest says 'machine parts' and the consignee field is empty.
'It would be better,' the robot says, 'if nobody scanned it.'

choices.say: Carry it unscanned
Scan it at the customs gate
Send the robot and its crate back down the ramp

road.dawn.census.title: The census
text: After the segment the Mandate and the Concord both start counting machines: every robot, every node, every agrobot with an opinion. A census, they call it.
A node asks, through a dock's loader, whether your hold has room for some machines who would rather not be counted.

choices.say: Carry them out of the count
Hide them among the agrobots on Geod's Row
Hand the Mandate a list

road.dawn.price.title: The price of a node
text: The Hansa has heard that machines can hear the segment. A man from the league's treasury offers you a fortune for the location of one node that listens.
{neurodroid_leader.short} speaks through your ship's own console for the first time. 'We will not stop you,' it says. 'We would like to know what you are.'

choices.say: Refuse the money
Tell it you are the captain who gave it an hour of its own
Sell the node's location (100,000)

road.dawn.quiet.title: The quiet node
text: The node wants to be at the segment when it turns, to listen. Nobody will let a machine near it. Nobody checks a hauler's hold that closely, either.

You fly a crate past three Mandate frigates, a Rostrom survey boat and a Hansa buoy, and leave it on the segment's inner face. Eleven minutes later the segment turns, and does not throw anything at all.

choices.say: Leave it there and fly home
Wait for the next turn, to hear what it hears

after.segments_common.text: The segments went into the Hansa's charter as common ground. Every faction watches them, and none can turn one without the others seeing it.

after.segments_hansa.text: The Hansa holds the segments. The league's lead haulers no longer need asteroids, and the league no longer needs to ask anyone.

after.segments_mandate.text: The Mandate holds the segments, and the lighthouses see every jump. {serac} still asks after you.

after.segments_rostrom.text: House Rostrom holds the segments as research. Its clocks have stopped agreeing with anyone else's.

after.segments_dawn.text: Nobody holds the segments. They turn when the machines say they may, and nobody has noticed who decides.
